deploybot: [migration-slot] Claim request: 06/01 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-8123 (staged functional index + compact backfill). Please ack in 10m or slot released. canaries=2.
Lina: Plan: build shadow index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, use chunked workers for backfill, then staged validation: first rename in us-east canaries, hold for 30m, then global rename. We'll gate reads on eu replicas during the initial global path until manual-unpin. Backfill throttle default=400 r/s.
Carter: Pin canaries to release-3.7.2-dbmerge to avoid accidental feature enable. If canary fails we'll revert canaries to release-3.7.1 and abort rollout. Also adding feature_flag:email_index_ready=false until final unpin.
SRE-oncall: I'll add region-aware autotune: if any replica_lag > 20s for >90s then reduce to 150 r/s; if lag >35s pause workers in that region and page #eng-sre. Health gates: p99 auth latency, p95 profile query, and replication lag. Pager cooldown set to 30m to minimize noise.
ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required to proceed past canary to global. Auto-abort on failed preflight. Release notes will include migration id m-8123 and tag release-3.7.2-dbmerge.
Lina: Quick safety: after swap we rename previous index to users_email_idx_prev and keep for 20m before async drop. That gives a quick rename revert path if we see regressions.
Dave: I'll own cutover (01:50-03:20 UTC). Smoke: GET /api/profile?email=test@x.com must be <200ms and 200 OK. I'll paste smoke timestamps & queries during rollout.
Carter: Runbook snippet (sanitized):
```
-- preflight
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IN ('idle in transaction');
SELECT application_name, client_addr, state, COALESCE(write_lag, replay_lag) FROM pg_stat_replication LIMIT 5;
-- progress
SELECT migration_id, phase, total_chunks, done_chunks FROM migration_tracker WHERE migration_id='m-8123';
```
Lina: SQL (redacted):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS users_email_fn_shadow ON users ((lower(email_normalized))) WITH (fillfactor=85);
-- background chunked workers fill shadow index
-- us-east canary swap: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_email_fn_shadow RENAME TO users_email_fn_idx; COMMIT;
-- schedule rename of previous index to users_email_idx_prev for 20m
```
SRE-oncall: Rollback options (documented):
1) Abort pre-swap: stop workers, keep old index -> zero user impact.
2) Post-swap quick revert (within retention window): under brief lock rename active->tmp, prev->active (expected lock <1s).
3) If prev dropped: full rebuild required (costly) and escalate to infra.
Carter: Also add a transient tourniquet: limit profile endpoint throughput to 60% for 15m around the swap to reduce blast radius if planner picks new index unexpectedly.
ops-bot: Note: metrics suppression request queued: mute index_build and duplicate planner metrics for 45m to avoid alert fatigue. Annotating dashboards with migration=m-8123.
Lina: I'll claim the slot now. deploybot 1: start canaries at 02:00 UTC and post status updates here.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Canary rollout scheduled in us-east only. Will post canary health and final go/no-go in thread.
